settings.lines:
Anti-slip silicone lining grips your pants
Split straps: no tourniquet behind the knee
Gel cushion over high-density foam
Hard cap slides on tile, pivots on subfloor

settings.text: Ships in 1–2 business days. Free US shipping on every order.

settings.heading: Fit & sizing
settings.content: One size fits most adults. Both straps adjust, and they fit over jeans, work pants or bibs. Snug the straps enough to hold, not to squeeze. The grip lining does the holding.

settings.heading: 30-day stay-up guarantee
settings.content: Wear them on the job. If they slide down or leave your legs numb, contact us within 30 days of delivery for a refund.

settings.subtitle: Anti-slip retention. Gel cushion. Hard cap. Built for the kneeling trades.

settings.items: Stays up, No tourniquet, Gel cushion, Hard cap, Free US shipping, 30-day guarantee

settings.heading: Kneel. Stand. Repeat all day.
settings.text: Watch what happens every time you get off your knees.

settings.title: Hard shell cap
settings.text: Takes the abuse from concrete, gravel and screws so the cushion underneath doesn't.

settings.title: Gel cushion
settings.text: Spreads your weight across the whole pad instead of the point of your kneecap.

settings.title: High-density foam
settings.text: Keeps its shape through long days instead of packing down flat in a month.

settings.title: Grip lining + split straps
settings.text: Grips your pants and holds the pad over the joint without a tight band behind the knee.

settings.heading: Four layers. Each with one job.

settings.them: One tight band behind the knee

settings.question: Will they really stay up?
settings.answer: That's what they're designed for. The silicone lining grips your pants and the two straps hold the pad over the joint. If they slide on you anyway, the guarantee covers it.

settings.question: Do they cut off circulation?
settings.answer: The straps sit above and below the knee instead of across the back of it, and they're wide, so the pressure is spread out.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders ship in 1–2 business days with free US shipping and a tracking link by email.
